exams.name: Illinois Plumber's License Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge and qualifications in planning and design of plumbing systems, manual skills, and knowledge of the State's minimum code of standards.
exams.quote: prepare and give uniform and comprehensive examinations to applicants for a plumber's license which shall test their knowledge and qualifications in the planning and design of plumbing systems

requirements.value: Applicant must be at least 21 years of age, and the Board must find that the requirements in the other state or municipality were substantially equal to Illinois requirements, and the same privilege must be accorded Illinois licensees by that state or municipality. If no reciprocal agreement exists, applicant must pass the Illinois plumber's examination.
requirements.quote: that the applicant is at least twenty-one years of age, and that the Board finds that the requirements for the registration or licensing of plumbers in such other state or municipality, were, at the date of the registration or license, substantially equal to the requirements then in force in this State

exists.quote: There is created an Illinois State Board of Plumbing Examiners which shall exercise its duties provided in this Act under the supervision of the Department.

name.value: Illinois State Board of Plumbing Examiners
name.quote: "Board" means the Illinois State Board of Plumbing Examiners.

authority.value: Aids the Director by preparing examination subject matter, suggesting rules for examinations and hearings, submitting recommendations for efficient administration, grading all tests and examinations, and performing other duties prescribed by the Director; operates under supervision of the Department.
authority.quote: The Board shall aid the Director and the Department by: (a) Preparing subject matter for examinations as provided in this Act. (b) Suggesting rules to govern examinations and hearings for suspension, revocation or reinstatement of licenses. (c) Submitting recommendations to the Director from time to time for the efficient administration of this Act. (d) Grading all tests and examinations for licenses and promptly reporting the results to the Director.

title_protection.quote: A person who practices, offers to practice, attempts to practice, or holds himself or herself out to practice as a plumber or plumbing contractor without being licensed or registered under this Act, shall, in addition to any other penalty provided by law, pay a civil penalty to the Department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or conspiring to obtain a license by payment of money or misrepresentation of facts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee or registrant obtained or conspired with others to obtain a license or registration by inducing the issuance thereof in consideration of the payment of money or delivery of any other thing of value or by and through misrepresentation of facts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating any law of Illinois or rule regulating plumbing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee or registrant willfully violated any law of this State or any rule, regulation or code promulgated thereunder regulating plumbing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence or incompetence in the performance of plumbing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee or registrant has been guilty of negligence or incompetence in the performance of plumbing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file a tax return or pay tax, penalty, or interest as required by any tax act administered by the Illinois Department of Revenue.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Department may refuse to issue or may suspend the license of any person who fails to file a return, or to pay the tax, penalty or interest shown in a filed return, or to pay any final assessment of tax, penalty or interest, as required by any tax Act administered by the Illinois Department of Revenue

bonding_required.quote: Applicants shall submit, on a form provided by the Department, an indemnification bond in the amount of $20,000 or a letter of credit in the same amount for work performed in accordance with this Act and the rules promulgated under this Act.

insurance_required.quote: Applicants shall submit an original certificate of insurance documenting that the contractor carries general liability insurance with a minimum of $100,000 per occurrence, a minimum of $300,000 aggregate for bodily injury, property damage insurance with a minimum of $50,000 or a minimum of $300,000 combined single limit, and workers compensation insurance with a minimum $500,000 employer's liability.
